## Sample inquiry response

Draft only. No message has been sent.

**English:**

Hi, thanks for getting in touch with Digits Studio. I'm Ahmad.

Tell me a little about your business, what you need help with and when you'd like to launch. If you have an existing website or social page, send the link too. A budget range is useful if you've already set one.

I'll review the details and suggest the next step. Once we define the scope, I'll prepare a proposal with the deliverables, timeline and fees.

**Arabic:**

أهلاً، وشكراً لتواصلك مع ديجيتس ستوديو. أنا أحمد.

خبرني شوي عن شغلك، بشو بدك مساعدة، وإيمتى حابب تطلق المشروع. وإذا عندك موقع أو صفحة حالية، ابعتلي الرابط. وإذا محدّد ميزانية تقريبية، بتساعدنا نختار نطاق مناسب.

براجع التفاصيل ومنحدّد الخطوة الجاية. وبعد ما نتّفق على المطلوب، بحضّر عرض واضح بالخدمات والمهلة والتكلفة.

## Practical 30-day launch plan

The calendar starts when the launch materials are ready; Day 1 is not a fixed date. This is a manual plan, not a scheduled publishing service.

**Days 1–7:** Finalise logo assets and contact details, set up confirmed account names, add the bio and working contact link, check website mobile layouts and inquiries, then publish the launch post. Follow with the founder introduction. Record actual baseline profile visits and inquiries if the platform provides them.

**Days 8–14:** Publish the branding post. Share a simple story explaining the difference between a logo and the supporting identity. Prepare one accurately credited previous website example, subject to permission.

**Days 15–21:** Publish the website and bilingual posts. Share a mobile-screen walkthrough of a permitted project or a clearly labelled studio concept. Respond to inquiries personally and note recurring questions.

**Days 22–30:** Publish the marketing post. Turn a recurring inquiry into one useful story. Review actual post saves, meaningful replies, profile visits and qualified inquiries where available. Choose next month's topics based on those signals; do not present reach alone as a business result.

Use the six main posts as a manageable baseline. Adjust the pace to available time and the quality of the work. Keep prospect outreach drafts separate; publishing this calendar does not authorize unsolicited messaging.
